# [TASK] Kibana homepage linking the Lens dashboard suite

## Task
Add a Kibana homepage/landing dashboard that links the 3 Lens dashboards from #71 (Service Health, Error Triage, Per-Service Deep-Dive), so there's one obvious starting point instead of navigating Kibana's dashboard list.

## Parent Story
Parent: #90

## Scope
Small nice-to-have. A simple markdown/links panel dashboard is enough — no new data visualizations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A Kibana dashboard (or Kibana's own "default route" setting) that surfaces links to all 3 dashboards from #71
- [x] Checked into `infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/*.ndjson`, imported by `setup.sh`

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
Did both halves of the "or": a new `filmpire-homepage.ndjson` dashboard (a
single markdown panel linking Service Health / Error Triage /
Per-Service Deep-Dive by their dashboard IDs) *and* set Kibana's
`defaultRoute` advanced setting to point straight at it, so opening Kibana
lands there instead of the dashboard list.

Verified against a live local Kibana (8.15.3), not just by reading the
schema:
- Re-ran the `elk-setup` one-shot container against the already-running
  local stack. Import returned `successCount:1` with no errors/warnings.
- `GET /api/saved_objects/dashboard/filmpire-homepage` confirms the stored
  markdown panel content and links.
- `GET /api/kibana/settings` confirms `defaultRoute.userValue` is
  `/app/dashboards#/view/filmpire-homepage`.
- All 3 linked dashboard IDs (`filmpire-service-health`,
  `filmpire-error-triage`, `filmpire-per-service-deep-dive`) resolve with
  HTTP 200.
